title: Apples and Pencils
text:
Anna has twenty-five apples. She buys thirty more at the market. Now she has fifty-five apples in her bag.

Her brother Tom has forty pencils. He gives ten to his sister. Now he has thirty pencils for school.

questions.text: How many apples does Anna have at first?
How many pencils does Tom have at first?
What kind of person is Tom?
Why does Anna's bag feel heavier at the end of the day?
options: She has many more apples now.
She has lost all of her apples.
She has given her bag to Tom.

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy and sell things
something you use to carry things
thin tools used for writing or drawing

paragraph_translations: Anna ma dwadzieścia pięć jabłek. Kupuje trzydzieści więcej na targu. Teraz ma pięćdziesiąt pięć jabłek w torbie.
Jej brat Tom ma czterdzieści ołówków. Daje dziesięć siostrze. Teraz ma trzydzieści ołówków do szkoły.
